outcome: Rate of emergency caesarean deliveries for foetal distress
cohort: 395 women who underwent emergency caesarean delivery for foetal distress at Chris Hani Baragwanath Academic Hospital in February 2019
finding: This study found that a decision to delivery interval (DDI) of 30 minutes was not achieved at Chris Hani Baragwanath Academic Hospital during the study period, and that most babies diagnosed with foetal distress pre-delivery had 5-minute and 10-minute Apgar scores inconsistent with this diagnosis.
